aliases.description: the main model, with a small window for this example
a quick model that writes the summaries

tools.name: python
tools.description: Run a Python script with /usr/bin/python3, given as code or as a file path, in workspace/. Returns the exit code, stdout and stderr, and for an uncaught exception its type, message and traceback with file and line. Prefer this to running python through the shell. Times out like the shell tool; a script is never run again automatically.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file. Lines come numbered; read a large file in parts with offset and limit. Relative paths are relative to workspace/.

tools.name: skill
tools.description: Load a skill listed under Skills in your instructions: its instructions, and the files that come with it. With file, read one of those files instead.

tools.name: spawn_subagent
tools.description: start a subagent on a subtask

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file with the given content. Missing directories are created. inputs/ is read-only; put deliverables in output/.
